lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since two years.
Better: I have lived here for two years.
Use for with an amount of time.
For! I waited for two hours.

data.wrong: I live here since two years.
data.right: I have lived here for two years.
data.why: Use for with an amount of time.

native.tip: Para una duración usa “for” (for two years). “Since” es para un punto de inicio.
native.caption: En español “desde hace dos años”, pero en inglés no 😅 Di “I have lived here for two years.”, no “I live here since two years.”. ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “for”. “For” + duración; “since” + fecha de inicio. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “since two years”? Careful
